page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-144-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 144 dedicated vCPUs across 72 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The processor includes a 504 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for matrix multiplication. The system is equipped with 1116.0 GB of RAM, providing 7.75 GB of memory per core.

This server configuration includes 9383 GB of local storage delivered via 24 NVMe SSDs. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The high-density local storage configuration is bundled directly with the compute resources, offering substantial local capacity for data-intensive operations.

Benchmark data indicates a divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. The server achieves top-tier performance in multi-core CPU execution, memory bandwidth, and database operations, including Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput. However, single-core CPU performance falls within the average tier. Similarly, while LLM prompt processing speeds for small, medium, and large models rank in the top tier, text generation for small models remains in the average tier.

Given the high density of both memory and local NVMe storage, this server offers resource density suitable for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. It is optimized for large-scale database operations, multi-threaded data decompression, software compilation, and LLM prompt processing. The hardware profile is less suited for workloads dependent on high single-threaded CPU performance.
